This bean plot is small, only a small piece of my land. I save my fertilizer coupon for the maize plot because maize needs it more, and beans can grow without much fertilizer — they help the soil themselves. I will use the seeds I kept from last season, put some manure from my goats if I have enough, and my wife and I will do the weeding ourselves. I cannot afford pesticides or to hire people for such a small plot.
